what: Pre-registered research hypotheses for the model-versus-market program. Each names its test (tools/market_intel/validation_report.js TESTS), its data and its acceptance rule before it is judged. The report never edits this file. A REJECTED hypothesis stays here with its result; RETIRED is set by a person, with a reason.
registration_note: Every hypothesis was in this file by 2026-10-23T21:08:19Z (the time recorded on each). H-001 to H-010 were written before tools/market_intel/validation_report.js first ran; H-011 to H-013 were written after its exploratory results were read, which is why their windows start on 2026-10-24. Amendments are listed on the hypothesis they changed.

kinds.EXPLORATORY: Formed after the data in its window had been looked at (seen_before_registration: true). Its result describes that data and confirms nothing.
kinds.CONFIRMATORY: Registered before any game in its window was played. The only kind whose ACCEPTED status is evidence.

hypotheses.statement: Where the CFB model's last pregame spread disagrees with the close, the disagreement predicts the final margin beyond the close
hypotheses.mechanism: An independent rating that sees efficiency and personnel the market under-weights would leave the close systematically wrong in the direction of the model
hypotheses.metric: information slope of (final - close) on (model - close), cluster bootstrap by week
hypotheses.failure_mode: The close already contains the model's inputs; the residual disagreement is model error

hypotheses.statement: Same as H-001, on CFB games played after registration
The CFB model prices FBS-vs-FCS games short of the close: the closing favourite's margin (the FBS team in 71 of the 73 games to date) is lower in the model than in the market
hypotheses.mechanism: Every FCS team is priced from one shared floor rating (football/cfb_p4/params.js fcs_rating -28) and ratings are learned on margins clamped at +/-35 (football/cfb_p4/engine.js), so a mismatch whose real margin often exceeds 35 is fitted to a capped expectation
hypotheses.metric: mean of (model - close) in FBS-team points (home-signed margin times the sign of the closing favourite), cluster bootstrap by week
hypotheses.failure_mode: The shortfall is a handful of extreme games (an FCS opponent missing its roster) rather than a systematic offset

amendments.what: statement reworded to say the test is signed by the closing favourite (the FBS team in 71 of 73 games); the test, slice, window and acceptance rule are unchanged

hypotheses.statement: Same as H-003, on FBS-vs-FCS games played after registration
hypotheses.failure_mode: Few FBS-vs-FCS games remain in a season after October; the window may never reach the minimum before the 2027 season

hypotheses.statement: The market moves toward the CFB model after EdgeDesk first publishes beside a quote (the close is nearer the model than the first quote was)
hypotheses.mechanism: If the model sees information before the market prices it, later prices drift toward the model; this is closing-line movement, not profit
hypotheses.metric: information slope of (close - first quote) on (model - first quote)
hypotheses.failure_mode: Movement toward the model is the market moving toward its own consensus, which the model also tracks (shared inputs), not information the model added

hypotheses.statement: The CFB model's win probability scores better (lower Brier) than the no-vig closing moneyline on the same games
hypotheses.mechanism: An independent probability that is better calibrated than the close
hypotheses.metric: paired Brier difference model - market, cluster bootstrap by week
hypotheses.failure_mode: The close is the stronger forecaster; the model's Brier is worse

hypotheses.statement: The CFB model's win probabilities are overconfident (calibration slope below 1)
hypotheses.mechanism: Earlier EdgeDesk analysis reported excessive confidence in large favourites; a margin-to-probability spread that is too narrow would show as a slope below 1
hypotheses.metric: logistic calibration slope with a cluster bootstrap interval
hypotheses.failure_mode: The earlier finding was fixed (or was a backtest artifact); 2026 live probabilities are consistent with calibration

hypotheses.statement: Where the NFL model's last pregame spread disagrees with the close, the disagreement predicts the final margin beyond the close
hypotheses.mechanism: As H-001, for the NFL engine
hypotheses.metric: information slope, cluster bootstrap by week
hypotheses.failure_mode: Six weeks of one season is too few games to tell

hypotheses.statement: The NHL model's win probability scores better (lower Brier) than the no-vig DraftKings moneyline last observed before the start
hypotheses.mechanism: An xG-based team model that sees goaltending and shot quality the market under-weights
hypotheses.metric: paired Brier difference model - market, cluster bootstrap by slate day
hypotheses.failure_mode: The market is the stronger forecaster in hockey, where per-game signal is small

hypotheses.statement: The NBA model's win probability scores better (lower Brier) than the no-vig DraftKings moneyline last observed before the start
hypotheses.metric: paired Brier difference model - market, cluster bootstrap by slate day
hypotheses.failure_mode: Early-season NBA ratings carry little information; the market prices late injury news the model may not see

hypotheses.statement: In FBS-vs-FBS games, the close moves toward the CFB model's number from the first quote EdgeDesk recorded beside it
hypotheses.mechanism: The exploratory 2026 data showed a slope of about 0.11 in this slice only (not pre-registered; BH-adjusted p about 0.05); if the model sees information early, later prices drift toward it
hypotheses.metric: information slope of (close - first quote) on (model - first quote), cluster bootstrap by week, robust to dropping any one week
hypotheses.failure_mode: The first quote is a noisy opener that reverts to a consensus the model also tracks; movement toward the model is shared inputs, not information the model added. Movement is not profit either way

hypotheses.statement: The NFL close moves toward the NFL model's number from the first quote EdgeDesk recorded beside it
hypotheses.mechanism: As H-011; the exploratory NFL slope was about 0.14 (BH-adjusted p about 0.05)

hypotheses.statement: After the 2026-10-19 home-field change (edgedesk_cfb_p4_v1.0.1, one 2.8-point home field), the CFB model's home lean against the close in FBS-vs-FBS games is under one point
hypotheses.mechanism: v1.0.0 learned 3.2 and projected 4.082 points of home field and leaned 1.4 points home of the close, in its 2022-2025 replay and again live in 2026; one 2.8-point home field should remove most of that lean
hypotheses.metric: mean of (model margin - close margin), home-signed, cluster bootstrap by week, robust to dropping any one week
hypotheses.failure_mode: The lean came from something other than the home-field constant (the seed ratings, neutral-site handling), so it persists under v1.0.1

amendments.what: slice narrowed from every v1.0.1 game to FBS-vs-FBS v1.0.1 games, because FBS-vs-FCS games (H-003) would pull a home lean down for a reason unrelated to the home field
amendments.note: no game in the window (from 2026-10-24) had been played
